Opposite-sign intervals around two interpolation sites give \(Q_{ij}<0\). (3) ODE arc minimization at \(s=1\) yields exact nearest-neighbor Q. value.rationale: This identifies an intrinsic sharp smoothness phase boundary of conditional dependence for a natural Fourier-spectral circular Matérn Gaussian family, arbitrary irregular finite sites and all positive range scales. It separates dense attractive graphical structure below \(s=1\), exact local Markov sparsity at \(s=1\), and provable non-attractivity above \(s=1\), with a closed four-point universal converse and exact positive zeta constant. This precise classification informs Gaussian graphical modeling and covariance-to-precision inversion beyond routine finite computations.
